summary: At the 0.40 similarity floor, 1/7 (14.3%) abstained queries had judged-relevant rank-1 precedents vs 41/86 (47.7%) answered queries. Fisher's exact test yields odds ratio = 5.4667, p = 0.1232 (not statistically significant at alpha = 0.05). The difference is directionally consistent; n=7 abstained limits statistical power. AUROC = 0.6671 reflects a weak-to-moderate guard rather than a sharp noise boundary.
